name: Executive Order 14319: Preventing Woke AI in the Federal Government
gloss: Presidential Executive Order enforcing strict truth-seeking and ideological neutrality principles on all federally procured generative models.

name: Executive Order 14409: Promoting Advanced Artificial Intelligence Innovation and Security
gloss: Executive Order establishing a voluntary 30-day pre-release review window for covered frontier models and creating the Treasury-led AI Cybersecurity Clearinghouse.

name: NIST AI Risk Management Framework (AI RMF 1.0)
gloss: Voluntary consensus-based framework for managing AI lifecycle trust through Govern, Map, Measure, and Manage functions.

name: NIST AI 600-1: Generative Artificial Intelligence Profile
gloss: NIST AI RMF companion profile targeting 12 specific generative AI risk vectors, including confabulation, privacy, and supply chain integrity.

name: California CPPA Automated Decision-Making Technology (ADMT) Regulations
gloss: Enforceable regulations under the CCPA framework mandating point-of-collection notices, GPC-binding opt-out toggles, and logic access rights for significant decisions.

name: California AB 2013 — Generative AI Training Data Transparency Act
citation: Cal. Civ. Code § 1798.140 et seq. (AB 2013, Ch. 353, Stats. 2024)
gloss: Statutory mandate requiring public 12-point training dataset metadata summaries with zero trade-secret exemptions for models trained since Jan 2022.

name: Texas Responsible AI Governance Act (TRAIGA)
gloss: Statute establishing the pro-business "Intent-as-Shield" defense, strict biometric informed consent rules, and the 36-month DIR regulatory sandbox.

name: EU AI Act: Article 50 — Transparency & Synthetic Media Disclosures
citation: Reg. (EU) 2024/1689, Art. 50, as amended by Reg. (EU) 2026/1744
gloss: Horizontal transparency obligations mandating chatbot disclosures, deepfake labeling, and machine-readable synthetic content watermarking.

frameworks.ref: v1.3 / v2.0 (named in the Jul 2026 Commission Guidelines as a compliant marking mechanism)

name: EDPB Opinion 28/2024 on personal data use in AI model development and deployment
gloss: Harmonized regulatory guidance on model-anonymization parameters (the "cake" metaphor) and downstream buyer audit liabilities (the "poisoned fruit" doctrine) under GDPR.

name: Careful Adoption of Agentic AI Services — Joint Five Eyes Cyber Security Guidance
gloss: Joint international cybersecurity advisory establishing Zero-Trust parameters, cryptographic machine identities, and containerized sandboxing rules for autonomous agents.
sourceLabel: Careful Adoption of Agentic AI Services (Five Eyes)

name: OWASP Top 10 for Large Language Model Applications (v2.0)
citation: OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications v2.0
gloss: The de facto industry secure-development vulnerability standard, targeting critical LLM risks like prompt injection, insecure output handling, and excessive agency.
sourceLabel: OWASP Top 10 for LLM Applications v2.0

name: Model risk management guidance
gloss: Fed, OCC and FDIC jointly superseded SR 11-7 with SR 26-2. Generative and agentic AI are explicitly out of scope pending a future RFI.

name: FTC enforcement under Section 5
gloss: No dedicated federal AI statute; the FTC continues to use its existing Section 5 unfair-or-deceptive-practices authority against AI-related claims.

name: Great American AI Act
gloss: Bipartisan discussion draft released June 4, 2026. Not yet formally introduced in Congress.

name: Colorado ADMT Act
gloss: Consequential-decision disclosure regime for automated decision-making. Signed May 14, 2026. Enforcement paused pending xAI v. Weiser litigation.

name: Colorado Chatbot Safety Act
gloss: Minor age-estimation, self-harm response protocols, and AI-disclosure requirements for consumer chatbots. Signed July 1, 2026.

name: California Transparency in Frontier AI Act (TFAIA)
gloss: Chaptered by the CA Secretary of State September 29, 2025. Frontier-model transparency obligations.

name: Illinois amendments on predictive analytics
gloss: Amends the Illinois Human Rights Act and Consumer Fraud and Deceptive Business Practices Act to reach predictive data analytics.

name: NYC automated employment decision tools
gloss: Mandatory bias audits for automated employment decision tools used in NYC hiring.

name: Utah Artificial Intelligence Policy Act
citation: SB 149, amended by SB 226, SB 271, SB 332, HB 452
gloss: Disclosure and liability framework for generative AI use in consumer-facing contexts, amended in each subsequent session.

name: Washington surveillance pricing bill
gloss: Restricts AI-driven personalized/surveillance pricing. In House Appropriations as of this check, not yet passed.

name: New York DFS cybersecurity guidance for AI
gloss: Non-binding industry letter on heightened cybersecurity risks associated with frontier AI models, building on DFS's Oct 2024 AI guidance.

name: New York RAISE Act
citation: Ch. 361, 2025 N.Y. Laws, as amended Mar. 2026
gloss: Frontier-model safety framework signed Dec 19, 2025, with chapter amendments aligning it to California SB 53. New NYDFS oversight office.

name: Virginia High-Risk AI Developer and Deployer Act
gloss: Would have mirrored Colorado's original ADMT framework. Governor Youngkin vetoed; the House sustained the veto.

name: China interim measures for generative AI services
gloss: CAC-led generative AI measures. Monitored via a Library of Congress Global Legal Monitor summary, not a live CAC feed — treat as secondary pending a primary-source fetch.
sourceLabel: China Interim Measures for Generative AI Services

name: Canada Artificial Intelligence and Data Act
citation: Part of Bill C-27. Died on prorogation, Jan 2025
gloss: AIDA died when Bill C-27 lapsed at prorogation. No successor bill introduced as of this check.

name: United Kingdom sectoral approach
gloss: No AI-specific UK statute exists. Regulators apply existing sectoral powers under non-statutory government principles.

name: Korea Framework Act on Artificial Intelligence
gloss: In force with a one-year grace period on penalties. High-performance threshold set at 10^26 FLOPs; extraterritorial domestic-representative rules apply above revenue/user thresholds.

name: ISO/IEC 42001
gloss: Certifiable AI management system standard. Stage 60.60 (published, no revision proposed).
